page.title: 一歩退く助動詞と仮定法

analysis.summaryJa: would・could・mightなどの過去形助動詞は、単なる過去時制だけでなく断定・確実性・対人圧力から一歩退く働きを持つ。また現在の現実から距離を取る過去形は仮定法を作り、wishやif節で『実際はそうではない』現在の状況を示す。
grammarPoints: will→would、can→could、may→mightで断定や圧力を弱められる
Would you...? は依頼を柔らかくする
I wish + 過去形は現在の事実に反する願望を表す
If + 過去形, would + 原形で現在の非現実的仮定を表す
仮定法の過去形は必ずしも過去時を意味しない
visualEvidence: 確実性の階段を一段下がる図が助動詞の弱まりを示している
透明な別世界バブルが現在の現実と仮定世界の距離を示している
wish内の過去形がNOWを指す図が時制と非現実性の違いを示している
commonTraps: could/mightを常に過去の能力・許可と解釈する
wishのknew/hadを過去時間だと誤解する
現在の仮定なのにif節へwillを置く
wouldの後ろを過去形にする
If I were...の非現実性を見落とす

questions.prompt: Would you ------- the conference room door, please?
questions.translationJa: 会議室のドアを開けていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: wouldの後ろには動詞原形openを置き、依頼を柔らかくします。

questions.prompt: It ------- rain later, so the outdoor reception may be moved inside.
questions.translationJa: 後で雨が降るかもしれないので、屋外レセプションは屋内へ移される可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: mightは控えめな可能性を表し、後ろには原形rainを置きます。
questions.focus: mightによる控えめな可能性

questions.prompt: I wish I ------- more time to review the proposal today.
questions.translationJa: 今日、その提案を確認する時間がもっとあればいいのですが。
questions.explanationJa: 現在は時間が十分ないという現実に反する願望なのでwish＋過去形hadを使います。

questions.prompt: If I ------- more staff, I would extend the support hours.
questions.translationJa: もっと人員がいれば、サポート時間を延長するのですが。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の非現実的仮定なのでif節は過去形had、主節はwould＋原形です。

questions.prompt: That ------- be the most practical option, although we need more data.
questions.translationJa: それが最も実用的な選択肢かもしれませんが、さらにデータが必要です。
questions.explanationJa: couldは断定を避けた可能性を表し、beは原形です。

questions.prompt: If the office ------- closer to the station, more employees would commute by train.
questions.translationJa: オフィスが駅にもっと近ければ、より多くの社員が電車通勤するでしょう。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の現実と異なる仮定なのでwereを使います。

questions.prompt: I wish the supplier ------- able to deliver before Friday.
questions.translationJa: 仕入先が金曜日より前に配送できればいいのですが。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の実現困難な願望を表すためwish＋wereを使います。

questions.prompt: Could you ------- the revised estimate by noon?
questions.translationJa: 正午までに改訂見積書を送っていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: couldの後ろは動詞原形sendで、canより柔らかな依頼になります。

questions.prompt: If we ------- a larger budget, we would hire an additional designer.
questions.translationJa: 予算がもっとあれば、追加のデザイナーを雇うのですが。
questions.explanationJa: 現状では予算が足りないという現在の非現実的仮定なのでhadを使います。

questions.prompt: The delay ------- be caused by customs inspection, but we cannot confirm it yet.
questions.translationJa: 遅延は税関検査が原因かもしれませんが、まだ確認できません。
questions.explanationJa: 根拠が不十分な控えめな可能性にはmightが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct polite request.

choices.A: Would you sending the updated file today?
choices.B: Would you sent the updated file today?
choices.C: Would you sends the updated file today?
choices.D: Would you send the updated file today?

questions.translationJa: 今日、更新ファイルを送っていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Would youの後ろは原形sendです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing a present unreal wish.

choices.A: I wish I know the answer.
choices.B: I wish I knew the answer.
choices.C: I wish I will know the answer now.
choices.D: I wish I knowing the answer.

questions.translationJa: 答えが分かればいいのですが。
questions.explanationJa: 実際は今答えを知らないため、wish＋過去形knewを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct present unreal conditional.

choices.A: If I have more time, I would attend every session.
choices.B: If I will have more time, I would attend every session.
choices.C: If I had more time, I would attend every session.
choices.D: If I had more time, I attended every session tomorrow.

questions.translationJa: もっと時間があれば、すべてのセッションに参加するのですが。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の非現実的仮定はif＋過去形、would＋原形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence giving a tentative possibility rather than certainty.

choices.A: The new layout could improve customer flow.
choices.B: The new layout could improves customer flow.
choices.C: The new layout could improved customer flow.
choices.D: The new layout is could improve customer flow.

questions.translationJa: 新しいレイアウトは顧客の流れを改善する可能性があります。
questions.explanationJa: could＋原形improveで断定を避けた可能性を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an unlikely present condition.

choices.A: If the warehouse were closer, delivery times will shorter.
choices.B: If the warehouse is closer now, delivery times would be shorter.
choices.C: If the warehouse will be closer, delivery times would be shorter.
choices.D: If the warehouse were closer, delivery times would be shorter.

questions.translationJa: 倉庫がもっと近ければ、配送時間は短くなるのですが。
questions.explanationJa: 現実と異なる現在条件なのでwere＋would beを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the natural softer request.

choices.A: Can you perhaps opened the window?
choices.D: Could you to open the window?

questions.translationJa: 窓を開けていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: Could you＋原形はcanより一歩距離を置いた柔らかな依頼です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where past form refers to present unreality, not past time.

choices.A: I was at the conference yesterday.
choices.B: I wish I were at the conference now.
choices.C: I attended the conference last year.
choices.D: I had a meeting at nine yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 今その会議にいられたらいいのですが。
questions.explanationJa: nowがあるにもかかわらずwereを使い、現在の現実から距離を取っています。
questions.focus: 現在を指す仮定法過去

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing weak possibility.

choices.A: The meeting might to finish early.

questions.translationJa: 会議は早く終わるかもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: mightの後ろは原形finishです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence for a current counterfactual business plan.

choices.A: If we will own the building, we would renovate the lobby.
choices.B: If we own the building, we would renovated the lobby.
choices.C: If we owned the building, we would renovate the lobby.
choices.D: If we owned the building, we renovate yesterday.

questions.translationJa: もしその建物を所有していれば、ロビーを改装するのですが。
questions.explanationJa: 現在は所有していない前提の仮定法なのでowned＋would renovateです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct statement about past-shaped modals.

choices.A: They can create softer or less certain meanings in present contexts.
choices.B: They can only describe past events.
choices.C: They must always be followed by past-tense verbs.

questions.translationJa: 過去形の形をした助動詞は、現在の文脈でも柔らかさや不確実性を表せます。
questions.explanationJa: would/could/mightは時間以外の距離化にも使われます。
questions.focus: 過去形助動詞の距離化

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “That could be our best option.”

choices.A: The speaker presents it as a possible option without full certainty.
choices.B: The speaker proves it is certainly the only option.
choices.C: The option was possible only in the past.
choices.D: The speaker rejects the option completely.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は、それが最良の選択肢である可能性を断定せずに述べています。
questions.explanationJa: couldは確実性を一段下げた可能性を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Would you close the door?”

choices.A: The speaker forbids closing the door.
choices.B: The speaker reports that the door was closed yesterday.
choices.C: The speaker predicts the door will close by itself.
choices.D: The speaker makes a softened request to close the door.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はドアを閉めてほしいと柔らかく依頼しています。
questions.explanationJa: wouldが依頼の圧力を弱めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I wish I knew her extension.”

choices.A: I will never want her extension.
choices.B: I knew her extension yesterday and still certainly know it.
choices.C: I do not know her extension now, and I want to know it.
choices.D: I am asking her to change the extension.

questions.translationJa: 今は彼女の内線番号を知らず、知りたいと思っています。
questions.explanationJa: wish＋knewは現在の事実に反する願望です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “If I had a company car, I would drive to the branch.”

choices.A: I definitely had a company car yesterday.
choices.B: I probably do not have a company car now.
choices.C: I will certainly receive a company car tomorrow.
choices.D: I never travel to the branch.

questions.translationJa: 今は社用車を持っていない可能性が高い、という含意があります。
questions.explanationJa: 仮定法過去は現在の現実と距離を取った条件を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “It might snow tonight.”

choices.A: Snow tonight is possible but not certain.

questions.translationJa: 今夜雪が降る可能性はありますが、確実ではありません。
questions.explanationJa: mightは控えめな可能性を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “If the office were larger, we would add more desks.”

choices.A: The office will definitely expand tomorrow.
choices.B: The office certainly became larger yesterday.
choices.C: The office is likely not large enough now.
choices.D: The company refuses to add desks for any reason.

questions.translationJa: 現在のオフィスは十分広くない可能性が高い、という意味です。
questions.explanationJa: were/wouldが現在の反事実・非現実条件を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Could you send the invoice again?”

choices.B: The speaker asks whether sending was physically possible only in childhood.
choices.C: The speaker states the invoice was already resent.
choices.D: The speaker politely asks for the invoice to be sent again.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は請求書を再送してほしいと丁寧に頼んでいます。
questions.explanationJa: couldは現在の依頼を柔らかくします。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I wish the meeting were shorter.”

choices.A: The meeting is not as short as the speaker wants now.
choices.B: The meeting was short yesterday and the speaker is satisfied.
choices.C: The meeting will certainly be cancelled.
choices.D: The speaker has no opinion about its length.

questions.translationJa: 今の会議は話し手が望むほど短くありません。
questions.explanationJa: wish＋wereは現在の現実への不満・反対願望を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Would be” in “That would be helpful.”

choices.A: It always means the help occurred yesterday.
choices.B: It can soften the statement and present the judgment less directly.
choices.D: It must be followed by a past participle.

questions.translationJa: その判断を直接言い切らず、柔らかく提示できます。
questions.explanationJa: wouldは断定から距離を取り、控えめな評価を作れます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Past-shaped forms can signal remoteness.”

choices.A: They can never refer to present situations.
choices.B: They always move every event to yesterday.
choices.C: They can distance a statement from certainty, directness, or current reality.

questions.translationJa: 過去形の形は、確実性・直接性・現在の現実から距離を取ることがあります。
questions.explanationJa: このページの中心概念をまとめた言い換えです。

questions.prompt: The receptionist wants to sound polite. “------- you sign here, please?”
questions.translationJa: 受付係は丁寧に『こちらに署名していただけますか』と言います。
questions.explanationJa: Would you＋原形は柔らかな依頼です。

questions.prompt: The forecast is uncertain. The airport ------- close temporarily if the wind gets stronger.
questions.translationJa: 予報は不確かです。風が強まれば空港が一時閉鎖されるかもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: 不確実な可能性を表すmightが自然です。

questions.prompt: The manager cannot attend the overseas conference. She says, “I wish I ------- there with the team.”
questions.translationJa: マネージャーは海外会議に参加できません。『チームと一緒にそこにいられたらいいのに』と言います。
questions.explanationJa: 今そこにいない現実に反する願望なのでwereを使います。

questions.prompt: Our current office is small. If we ------- more space, we would create a separate training room.
questions.translationJa: 現在のオフィスは狭いです。もっとスペースがあれば、独立した研修室を作るのですが。
questions.explanationJa: 現状と異なる仮定なのでhadを使います。

questions.prompt: A client asks for advice, but the consultant is not completely certain. “That ------- be the safer approach.”
questions.translationJa: 顧客が助言を求めていますが、コンサルタントは完全には確信していません。『その方法のほうが安全かもしれません』。
questions.explanationJa: couldが判断を断定せず控えめに示します。

questions.prompt: The speaker wants a very soft request: “------- you possibly move the appointment to Thursday?”
questions.translationJa: 話し手は非常に柔らかく『可能なら予約を木曜日に変更していただけますか』と頼みます。
questions.explanationJa: Could you possibly＋原形は丁寧で控えめな依頼です。

questions.prompt: The company does not own the site. If it ------- the property, it would build a larger warehouse there.
questions.translationJa: 会社はその土地を所有していません。所有していれば、そこにもっと大きな倉庫を建てるのですが。
questions.explanationJa: 現在の事実に反する仮定なのでownedを使います。

questions.prompt: The employee does not know the password. “I wish I ------- it so I could finish the setup.”
questions.translationJa: 社員はパスワードを知りません。『分かれば設定を終えられるのに』。
questions.explanationJa: 現在知らない事実に反する願望なのでknewです。

questions.prompt: The proposal is one of several possibilities. The director says it ------- reduce costs, but more analysis is needed.
questions.translationJa: その提案は複数の可能性の一つです。部長はコストを削減できるかもしれないと言いますが、さらに分析が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: couldは確定していない可能性を表します。

questions.prompt: The speaker contrasts reality and imagination: “If I ------- fluent in German, I would lead the Berlin meeting myself.”
questions.translationJa: 『ドイツ語が流暢なら、ベルリン会議を自分で進行するのですが』。
questions.explanationJa: 現在は流暢ではないという非現実的仮定なのでwereを使います。
